identificationModule.officialTitle: Single Arm, Two Phase, Multicenter Clinical Trial to Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of the CAR-T for Recurrent or Refractory Diffuse Large B Cell Lymphoma

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a single-arm, multicenter Phase 2 study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of the CAR-T for Recurrent or refractory diffuse large B cell lymphoma.The study will be conducted using a phase I/II design. The study will have the following sequential phases: Part A (screening leukapheresis,cell product preparation, and cytoreductive chemotherapy) and Part B (treatment and follow-up). The follow-up period for each participant is approximately 35 months after the final CAR-T infusion. The total duration of the study is expected to be approximately 3 years. A total of 24 patients may be enrolled over a period of 3 years.
